input: Write a haiku a day for one month

gold.taskTitle: Write a haiku every day for one month
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to write one haiku per day consistently for a full month.

questions.title: Which month are you starting this challenge?
questions.description: Identify the specific start date or month for the haiku challenge.

questions.title: Will your haikus follow a specific theme or topic?
questions.description: Determine whether the haikus will be thematic (e.g. nature, emotions, daily life) or completely free-form.

questions.title: Do you want to follow strict 5-7-5 syllable structure?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants to stick to the traditional 5-7-5 syllable format or explore looser modern haiku styles.

questions.title: Where will you write and store each haiku?
questions.description: Identify the medium or tool the user will use to write and keep their haikus, such as a notebook, app, or document.

questions.title: What time of day will you write each haiku?
questions.description: Pin down a preferred daily writing time to help build a consistent habit.

questions.title: Do you plan to share these haikus with anyone?
questions.description: Find out if the haikus are private, shared with friends, or published publicly on a platform.

questions.title: What happens if you miss a day?
questions.description: Establish the user's preferred approach to accountability or catch-up if they skip a day.
